messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] rqtl tutorial for recombinant inbred line ( RIL) population
parts:
This forum works best if you ask more specific questions.

RIL in R/qtl have cross type "risib" or "riself". In the call to read.cross, you can use crosstype="riself", for example. 

QTL analysis proceeds just like analysis of a backcross, as there are two possible genotypes.  

karl
